subject: MPA: security gates & retention boundaries for Sunrise Bank evaluation
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.h@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@sunrisebank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.d@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MPA: security gates & retention boundaries for Sunrise Bank evaluation

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for the time today. Attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for the evaluation and pilot with Sunrise Bank. High level items we captured on the call around security/compliance gates:

- SOC 2: Redwood will provide our latest Type II report and the control mapping for the evaluation scope.
- SIG/CAIQ: We will complete the CAIQ questionnaire and mark any controls that are out of scope for a closed pilot region.
- DPA: We have a draft DPA; legal will accept reasonable redlines. Please flag any specific clauses (data location, subprocessors) you want to escalate.
- Data retention: Proposed default artifact/log retention = 90 days; request logs (token-level) available for 90 days; backups retained per agreed schedule — we listed options below.

Immediate asks from our side:
1) Confirm whether Sunrise requires token-level logging beyond 90 days or any regulatory retention (e.g., 7+ years) for specific data classes.
2) Confirm the CAIQ completion owner on your side (legal/security).
3) Any required proof-of-concept (PoC) sandbox region preference (us-east-1 vs us-west-2).

Attachments: redwood_map_v1.pdf (MAP with milestones), SOC2_summary.pdf (redacted), SIG-questions.docx (we included the initial CAIQ flags).

Proposed timeline (draft):
- Week 0: MAP sign-off + sandbox access
- Week 1–2: Technical PoC (functionality + latency checks)
- Week 2–4: Security intake & CAIQ evidence exchange
- Week 3–5: Legal/DPA redline cycle

We can tighten any of the above windows — tell us what is critical for Sunrise and we will prioritize.

Best,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina.h@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@sunrisebank.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.h@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sunrise Bank Legal <legal@sunrisebank.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Apr 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MPA: security gates & retention boundaries for Sunrise Bank evaluation

Thanks, Mina —

Appreciate the clear MAP. A few clarifying points from Legal & InfoSec before we sign:

- Data retention: Our baseline requirement for transaction logs and audit trails is 7 years, but we may accept a 90-day rolling access window for token-indexed telemetry if the long-term copies are stored encrypted, immutable, and accessible for regulatory requests. We need Redwood to confirm the backup/archival encryption and retrieval process.
- Token-level logs: We consider token-level logs as sensitive; can you confirm what PII (if any) is captured in those logs and options to redact or pseudonymize?
- CAIQ: We need the CAIQ back-completed within 10 business days of MAP sign-off. Is that timeline feasible?
- DPA redlines: Our counsel will send an initial redline. Expect [legal@sunrisebank.com] to be the sender.

Also: for the PoC sandbox — we prefer us-west-2 for lower latency to our internal teams.

Attached: SIG-questions.docx (our annotated asks).

Laura Chen
Head of Vendor Risk | Sunrise Bank
laura.chen@sunrisebank.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.h@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.d@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Apr 2028 13:24:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: MPA: security gates & retention boundaries for Sunrise Bank evaluation

Looping internal owners — quick plan to address Laura's asks and keep close timeline:

1) SOC 2 evidence: We will provide the full redacted SOC 2 Type II (control narratives + testing results) within 24 hours of MAP sign-off. Action: Mina to upload to HubSpot secure folder.
2) CAIQ turnaround: Priyom — can you and the security team commit to CAIQ completion within 7 business days after sign-off? We can triage the most sensitive controls first (encryption, key mgmt, subproc).
3) Data retention options: propose three options we can present to Sunrise:
   a) Standard: 90-day active logs + 7-year encrypted archive for regulatory retrieval (archive access via signed request, 5 business day SLA).
   b) Privacy-first: redact PII from token logs, 90-day active, 1-year archive.
   c) Minimal: 30-day active logs, 1-year archive, no token-level export by default.
Action: Priyom to confirm technical feasibility and estimated engineering effort for (a)-(c).
4) DPA: Legal will expect to see redline. Suggested internal owner: Marissa lead + Legal review. Anticipate 10 business days for initial review; push for a 5-business-day turnaround if Sunrise can accept standard redlines.

Proposed tightened MAP timeline if Sunrise agrees to our evidence cadence:
- Day 0: MAP sign-off + DocuSign link out
- Day 1–2: SOC 2 drop + sandbox provisioning (us-west-2)
- Day 3–9: CAIQ completion & evidence exchange
- Day 5–12: Legal DPA redline cycle (concurrent)
- Day 10–14: Final acceptance decision / pilot extension or close

Priyom — can you confirm whether archive retrieval (7-year) needs a separate SR/contract and whether we support immutable WORM storage by default?

-Marissa
Marissa Cole

Subject: Re: MPA: security gates & retention boundaries for Sunrise Bank evaluation — timeline confirmation

Laura —

Thanks for the quick note and the annotated SIG file. We can accommodate the CAIQ within 10 business days as requested (Marissa proposed 7 business days internally; we will commit to 10 to match your ask).

Clarifications / commitments from Redwood:
- Backup/archive: Redwood uses encrypted, region-bound object storage for backups. Archives can be retained up to 7 years—access requires a signed request and will follow the retrieval SLA listed in the MAP. We can enable WORM-style retention for specific containers if needed (we'll log that in the MAP).
- Token-level logs: Default behavior captures token indexes and non-sensitive metadata. PII is not stored in token logs by default; we offer a redaction/pseudonymization pipeline for any payloads you mark as sensitive.
- CAIQ timeline: Committed — CAIQ completed and uploaded to the secure drive within 10 business days after MAP sign-off.
- DPA: We received your legal team's intent to redline. Please send to legal@redwood.ai and Cc me; Marissa will handle the first pass internally.

Next steps:
- I will send the DocuSign link for MAP sign-off by EOD.
- Marissa will drop SOC 2 artifacts to the secure folder as soon as the MAP is executed.
- Priyom will follow up with a short note on archive implementation and WORM support.

Proposed meeting to close MAP and start PoC: Wed 2028-04-25 10:00 AM PT. Does that work for your team?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
